description: This file defines setup functions and configuration handling for IRC channel integration within a plugin SDK, including parsing ports, updating account configs, setting policies, and applying account configurations.

methods.name: parsePort
methods.description: Parses a raw port string, returning a fallback if invalid or out of range.

methods.name: updateIrcAccountConfig
methods.description: Updates the IRC account configuration for a specific account ID.

methods.name: setIrcDmPolicy
methods.description: Sets the DM policy for IRC configuration.

methods.name: setIrcAllowFrom
methods.description: Sets the allowed sources for IRC.

methods.name: setIrcNickServ
methods.description: Configures NickServ settings for an IRC account.

methods.name: setIrcGroupAccess
methods.description: Configures group access policies for an IRC account.
